name: How do I know if a kitchen wall is load-bearing?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if a kitchen wall is load-bearing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Determining if a kitchen wall is load-bearing requires an assessment by a qualified professional, such as a structural engineer or an experienced general contractor. They will examine the wall's location, the framing above and below it, and the building's overall structural design. Attempting to remove a load-bearing wall without proper support can compromise the structural integrity of your home. It's a critical decision factor that dictates the complexity and cost of the removal project.
acceptedAnswer.description: A qualified professional must assess the wall's location and the building's structure to determine if it's load-bearing, a key decision factor.
